entities.summary: Marcus Taylor Paige is an American professional basketball coach and former player. He played college basketball for the North Carolina Tar Heels, where he helped lead the Tar Heels to the 2016 NCAA championship game, and now serves as an assistant coach at UNC Charlotte. In addition to being a citizen of the United States, Paige also has Serbian citizenship.
